title: WidgetVA: A Widget-Centric Framework and Benchmark for Agentic Visual Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2609.24094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual analytics (VA) enables sensemaking through interactive visualization, but effective analysis often requires experts to translate high-level intents into long sequences of interface operations and iteratively interpret visual feedback. We study whether modern vision-language models (VLMs) can take on this role as autonomous VA operators that observe the interface, plan multi-step exploration, execute interactions, and adapt based on intermediate visual feedback. To support systematic development and evaluation, we first introduce WidgetVA, a widget-centric agentic VA framework that standardizes interactive components as structured widgets with unified action (e.g., filter and zoom) and perception-query (e.g., selection summaries) APIs. translated_title: WidgetVA：一个以组件为中心的智能体式可视化分析框架与基准测试
translated_abstract: 可视化分析（VA）通过交互式可视化实现意义建构，但有效的分析往往需要专家将高层意图转化为长序列的界面操作，并迭代地解读视觉反馈。我们研究现代视觉语言模型（VLM）能否承担这一角色，成为自主的VA操作者，即观察界面、规划多步探索、执行交互，并根据中间视觉反馈进行调整。为支持系统化的开发与评估，我们首先提出了WidgetVA，一个以组件为中心的智能体式VA框架，它将交互组件标准化为结构化的组件，并配备统一的操作API（如筛选和缩放）和感知查询API（如选择摘要）。这种标准化支持两种系统构建模式：一是封装现有的VA系统，使其无需重建即可被智能体操作；二是将组件作为模块化构建单元来组装全新的系统。
tldr: 本文提出WidgetVA，一个以组件为中心的智能体式可视化分析框架与基准，通过将交互组件标准化为具有统一操作与感知查询API的结构化组件，使视觉语言模型能够作为自主操作者观察界面、规划多步探索并执行交互。
en_tdlr: WidgetVA introduces a widget-centric framework and benchmark that standardizes interactive components with unified action and perception-query APIs, enabling vision-language models to act as autonomous operators that observe interfaces, plan multi-step exploration, and execute interactions in visual analytics.
